summary.title: BaZi Structural Reading
summary.subtitle: Natal structure · patterns · schools · Luck Cycles · annual context
summary.boundary: This is an interpretive report from governed BaZi structure. It does not treat symbolic structure as observed fact or predict guaranteed events.
keyPoints: 癸 Water Day Master · 午 month command
Natal relations: stem combination, harm, and self-punishment

readingSections.title: Chart foundation
readingSections.dek: Day Master, month command, roots and the Ten-God configuration are read together.
paragraphs: The Day Master is 癸 Water. The month command is 午, placing the chart in a summer seasonal context. Root evidence records 癸 in the Day branch.

Visible relation counts are peer support 0, resource support 1, output/drain 0, controlled by Day Master 3, and pressure on Day Master 3. These are unweighted structural observations, not a strong/weak verdict.

Across visible and hidden stems, the larger unweighted Ten-God counts include Seven Killings × 4, Direct Resource × 2, Direct Officer × 2, Indirect Wealth × 2, and Direct Wealth × 1. Frequency is shown as structure, not converted into a personality conclusion.

readingSections.title: Natal relationships
readingSections.dek: Combinations, clashes and related structures are shown without turning them into event claims.
paragraphs: 癸–戊: stem combination, involving Day and Hour; 午–丑: harm, involving Month and Day; 丑–午: harm, involving Day and Hour; WU–WU: self-punishment, involving Month and Hour

readingSections.title: Pattern paths and conditions
readingSections.dek: Candidates, visibility and unresolved conditions remain explicit.
paragraphs: Month-command hidden stems produce candidate paths including 偏财 (not visible) and 七杀 (visible). W12 preserves the alternatives; the report does not invent a primary pattern.

headline.en: 癸 Day Master · 午 month command: read the whole-chart thread before individual symbols
headline.zhHans: 癸日主 · 午月令：先读整盘主线，再读单项符号

paragraphs.en: The most useful starting point is not a Ten-God catalogue, but how environment ↔ self anchor, rules, responsibility and pressure, and Seven Killings pattern path organize the chart together. They set the reading order for pattern, relationships, life domains and timing.
paragraphs.zhHans: 这张盘最值得先看的不是十神清单，而是月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点、规则、责任与压力、七杀格路径怎样同时组织整盘。它们会决定后面的格局、关系、人生主题与时间层应该用什么顺序阅读。

paragraphs.en: The raw Five-Element composition is led by earth at about 38.9%, but that is only background composition. The main thread still depends on month command, Day-Master carrying, functional groups and pillar interfaces working together.
paragraphs.zhHans: 原始五行里土约占 38.9%，但这只是组成背景。真正的主线仍要回到月令、日主承载、十神功能组与干支接口之间的组合。

title.en: environment ↔ self anchor is the first interface to read
title.zhHans: 月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点是整盘最先要看的接口

thesis.en: 午 and 丑 form a branch harm relation at an interface that directly touches both the Day Master and month command, so it can reshape how other themes work together.
thesis.zhHans: 午、丑之间形成地支相害，而且同时直接碰到日主与月令，所以它不是边缘信息，而是会改写其他主题怎样彼此配合的主线。

development.en: This interface pulls learning, support and absorption, resources and exchange, rules, responsibility and pressure, and peer and self-position into one reading. Rules, resources, support and expression should therefore be read together rather than as isolated symbols.
development.zhHans: 这条接口把学习、支持与吸收、资源与交换、规则、责任与压力、同类与自我位置拉进同一处阅读。也就是说，规则、资源、支持或表达不宜各自孤立解释，要看它们在环境与自我之间怎样同时发生。

condition.en: a branch harm relation describes structural interaction, not a guaranteed event. Its lived form still depends on context, role and later timing layers.
condition.zhHans: 地支相害描述的是结构关系，不等于现实里一定发生某类事件；真正表现仍取决于场景、角色与后续时间层。

title.en: rules, responsibility and pressure comes to the foreground
title.zhHans: 规则、责任与压力在十神结构中进入前景

thesis.en: This functional group accounts for about 46.2% of the current Ten-God occurrences and is carried mainly by Seven Killings and Direct Officer, so it is likely to reappear across several life domains.
thesis.zhHans: 这一功能组约占当前十神落点的 46.2%，主要由七杀、正官构成，因此它会反复出现在多个生活主题里。

development.en: rules, responsibility and pressure deserves early attention because it reconnects to multiple chart structures, not because a higher ratio is automatically better or a personality score.
development.zhHans: 「规则、责任与压力」值得优先读，不是因为占比越高就越“好”或越像人格标签，而是因为它和整盘其他结构有更多重复连接。

condition.en: Later topic chapters show how rules, responsibility and pressure changes by domain instead of repeating the same Ten-God definition seven times.
condition.zhHans: 后面的主题章节会继续说明「规则、责任与压力」在不同领域怎样改变，而不是把同一句十神定义重复七次。

title.en: Seven Killings pattern path is the second organizing path
title.zhHans: 七杀格路径是第二条组织路径

thesis.en: 七杀 enters the month-command pattern discussion with 0 visible formation paths and 2 relationship modifiers to review.
thesis.zhHans: 七杀从月令路径进入格局讨论，目前可见 0 条成格支持，同时有 2 项干支关系需要一起修正。

development.en: The useful question is not whether the chart can be given a pattern label, but whether formation support, Day-Master carrying, Ten-God composition and relationship modifiers can hold together.
development.zhHans: 因此这里真正要读的不是“有没有一个格局名称”，而是这些支持条件能否和日主承载、十神组合及关系修正同时成立。

condition.en: The path can be explained in depth without being promoted automatically to one final primary pattern.
condition.zhHans: 当前格局路径可以深入解释，但不会因为某一条件突出就自动升级成唯一主格。

title.en: Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading
title.zhHans: 日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题

thesis.en: The current carrying structure shows support, output and pressure are mixed: roots 1, visible support 0, drain/consumption 4, and pressure 3.
thesis.zhHans: 当前承载结构呈「支持、外泄与压力并见」：根气 1、可见生扶 0、泄耗 4、克 3。

development.en: This changes how much support, output cost and external demand the other themes can actually carry, which is more informative than applying a one-word strong/weak sticker.
development.zhHans: 这组结构决定其他主题落到现实运行时有多少支撑、多少输出成本、又要面对多少外部要求，因此它比单独贴“身强／身弱”更有解释力。

condition.en: This describes carrying conditions. It does not create a weighted strength score or turn a temporary pressure state into a fixed identity.
condition.zhHans: 这里读的是承载条件，不制造加权旺衰分数，也不把一个阶段性的压力状态当成固定身份。

title.en: learning, support and absorption comes to the foreground
title.zhHans: 学习、支持与吸收在十神结构中进入前景

thesis.en: This functional group accounts for about 23.1% of the current Ten-God occurrences and is carried mainly by Indirect Resource and Direct Resource, so it is likely to reappear across several life domains.
thesis.zhHans: 这一功能组约占当前十神落点的 23.1%，主要由偏印、正印构成，因此它会反复出现在多个生活主题里。

development.en: learning, support and absorption deserves early attention because it reconnects to multiple chart structures, not because a higher ratio is automatically better or a personality score.
development.zhHans: 「学习、支持与吸收」值得优先读，不是因为占比越高就越“好”或越像人格标签，而是因为它和整盘其他结构有更多重复连接。

condition.en: Later topic chapters show how learning, support and absorption changes by domain instead of repeating the same Ten-God definition seven times.
condition.zhHans: 后面的主题章节会继续说明「学习、支持与吸收」在不同领域怎样改变，而不是把同一句十神定义重复七次。

lead.en: Work is read here as the way output, responsibility, resources and learning are organized into a usable role.
lead.zhHans: 事业主题看的是表达产出、规则责任、资源交换与学习支持怎样组织成可持续的工作方式。

development.en: For career and work, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 46.2%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Indirect Wealth, and Direct Officer. It also connects to Seven Killings pattern path and Wealth pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as self anchor ↔ later expression and environment ↔ self anchor. It directly reconnects to 5 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「事业与工作」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 46.2%），主要连接到七杀、偏财、正官。同时可连接到七杀格路径、财格路径，并经过自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达、月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 5 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Career structure can change with role, organization and timing. This describes work dynamics rather than fixing one profession into a guaranteed success-or-failure outcome.
condition.zhHans: 事业结构会随角色、组织环境与阶段而改变；这里说明的是工作运行方式，不把它直接写成某个职业的固定成败结论。

lead.en: Wealth is read as the chart’s resource flow: what can be produced, managed, exchanged and protected.
lead.zhHans: 财富主题看的是资源怎样被产出、管理、交换与保留，而不是把一个财星直接等同于财富结果。

development.en: For wealth and resources, the leading functional group is resources and exchange at about 23.1%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Indirect Wealth, and Direct Officer. It also connects to Wealth pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as self anchor ↔ later expression and environment ↔ self anchor. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「财富与资源」而言，在这个主题里，「资源与交换」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 23.1%），主要连接到七杀、偏财、正官。同时可连接到财格路径，并经过自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达、月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Resource structure describes how money, opportunity and exchange enter the chart; it is not an income promise. Real outcomes still depend on choices, markets, responsibilities and timing.
condition.zhHans: 资源结构说明钱、机会与交换怎样进入命盘，不等同实际收入承诺；现实结果仍取决于选择、市场、责任与时间条件。

lead.en: Relationships are read through recurring interfaces between self-position, rules, resources and support, not through a single spouse label.
lead.zhHans: 关系主题看自我位置、规则、资源与支持怎样在不同关系接口里反复出现，而不是把某一柱直接等同某个人。

development.en: For relationships, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 46.2%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Indirect Wealth, and Direct Officer. It also connects to Seven Killings pattern path and Wealth pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as self anchor ↔ later expression and environment ↔ self anchor. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「关系」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 46.2%），主要连接到七杀、偏财、正官。同时可连接到七杀格路径、财格路径，并经过自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达、月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Relationship structure is best used to observe interaction style, boundaries and recurring interfaces rather than to predict marriage, separation or one fixed partner outcome.
condition.zhHans: 关系结构更适合观察互动方式、边界与反复接口，不把它直接翻译成结婚、分手或某一种伴侣结果。

lead.en: Family and background are read as the chart’s support, belonging and environmental interfaces rather than fixed family-member assignments.
lead.zhHans: 家庭与背景主题看支持、归属与环境接口怎样组合，不把某一柱固定对应成某位家人。

development.en: For family and background, the leading functional group is learning, support and absorption at about 23.1%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Indirect Wealth, and Direct Officer. It also connects to Wealth pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as self anchor ↔ later expression and environment ↔ self anchor. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「家庭与背景」而言，在这个主题里，「学习、支持与吸收」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 23.1%），主要连接到七杀、偏财、正官。同时可连接到财格路径，并经过自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达、月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Family roles and real people change across life stages, so this reading stays with support and environmental structure instead of assigning one pillar to one family member.
condition.zhHans: 家庭角色与现实成员会随人生阶段变化，因此这里只读支持与环境结构，不固定指定哪一柱就是哪一位家人。

lead.en: Capability is read from what can be absorbed, practiced, expressed and repeatedly carried.
lead.zhHans: 能力主题看一项东西能否被吸收、练习、表达并反复承载。

development.en: For capability and expression, the leading functional group is learning, support and absorption at about 23.1%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Direct Officer, and Direct Resource. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone and is modified by interfaces such as self anchor ↔ later expression and environment ↔ self anchor. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「能力与表达」而言，在这个主题里，「学习、支持与吸收」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 23.1%），主要连接到七杀、正官、正印。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径，并经过自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达、月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Reliability still depends on whether roots 1, support 0 and output cost 4 can work together over time.
condition.zhHans: 能力是否稳定，要继续看根气 1、生扶 0 与输出成本 4 能不能长期配合。

lead.en: Pressure is read from standards and control together with the support available to carry them.
lead.zhHans: 压力主题把规则与受克放在可用支持和承载条件里一起读。

development.en: For pressure and responsibility, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 46.2%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Direct Officer, and Direct Resource. It also connects to Seven Killings pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as self anchor ↔ later expression and environment ↔ self anchor. It directly reconnects to 5 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「压力与责任」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 46.2%），主要连接到七杀、正官、正印。同时可连接到七杀格路径，并经过自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达、月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 5 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: The carrying side currently shows support, output and pressure are mixed, so pressure should be read against visible support 0 and pressure 3, not Officer count alone.
condition.zhHans: 承载侧目前呈「支持、外泄与压力并见」，所以压力要同时看可用支持 0 与受克 3，不能只看官杀数量。

lead.en: Life operation asks whether support, output, resources, responsibility and relationships can circulate as one system.
lead.zhHans: 生活运行看支持、输出、资源、责任与关系能不能形成一套可持续循环。

development.en: For life operation, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 46.2%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Indirect Wealth, and Direct Officer. It also connects to Seven Killings pattern path and Wealth pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as self anchor ↔ later expression and environment ↔ self anchor. It directly reconnects to 5 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「生活运行」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 46.2%），主要连接到七杀、偏财、正官。同时可连接到七杀格路径、财格路径，并经过自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达、月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 5 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: The key is not which function wins permanently, but whether support, output, resources and responsibility can return to a sustainable circulation across changing periods.
condition.zhHans: 生活运行的关键不是哪一组永远占上风，而是支持、输出、资源与责任能否在不同阶段重新找到可持续的循环。

headline.en: Timing narrative becomes available after a complete target time is selected.
headline.zhHans: 选择完整目标时间后，才会生成当前时间窗口的连续解读。

prompt.en: For priority 1, “environment ↔ self anchor is the first interface to read”: Across different roles or environments, where does this same interface repeat—and where does it behave differently?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 1 条主线「月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点是整盘最先要看的接口」：把同一个接口放到不同角色或环境里看：哪些互动模式会重复，哪些情境下反而表现不同？

prompt.en: For priority 1, “environment ↔ self anchor is the first interface to read”: What lived example most clearly contradicts this relationship reading, and what condition was different in that case?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 1 条主线「月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点是整盘最先要看的接口」：哪一个真实例子最不符合这段关系解读？当时的环境、角色或资源条件有什么不同？

prompt.en: For priority 2, “rules, responsibility and pressure comes to the foreground”: In which recurring situations does this functional group become the default way you respond or organize action?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 2 条主线「规则、责任与压力在十神结构中进入前景」：在哪些反复出现的情境里，这个功能组最容易成为你默认的应对或行动方式？

prompt.en: For priority 2, “rules, responsibility and pressure comes to the foreground”: When another functional group takes over instead, what changed in the task, relationship, resources or pressure?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 2 条主线「规则、责任与压力在十神结构中进入前景」：当现实里反而由另一个功能组接管时，任务、关系、资源或压力条件发生了什么变化？

prompt.en: For priority 3, “Seven Killings pattern path is the second organizing path”: When this pattern path works best in real life, which supporting conditions tend to appear together rather than separately?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 3 条主线「七杀格路径是第二条组织路径」：这条格局路径在现实里运行得比较顺时，哪些支持条件通常会一起出现，而不是各自单独出现？

prompt.en: For priority 3, “Seven Killings pattern path is the second organizing path”: Can you identify a situation where the expected pattern did not show up even though one supporting factor was present?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 3 条主线「七杀格路径是第二条组织路径」：有没有一种情况：虽然某个成格支持已经出现，但整段格局表现并没有随之成立？

prompt.en: For priority 4, “Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading”: Take the same kind of task under two different conditions: when support is available and when pressure is high. What changes in stamina, pace or recovery?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 4 条主线「日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题」：拿同一类任务比较两个条件：支持充足时与压力偏高时，你的持续力、节奏或恢复方式有什么明显变化？

prompt.en: For priority 4, “Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading”: Which part of this carrying pattern feels stable across years, and which part appears mainly under specific environments or workloads?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 4 条主线「日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题」：这组承载模式里，哪些部分多年都比较稳定，哪些只在特定环境、工作量或责任阶段出现？

prompt.en: For priority 5, “learning, support and absorption comes to the foreground”: In which recurring situations does this functional group become the default way you respond or organize action?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 5 条主线「学习、支持与吸收在十神结构中进入前景」：在哪些反复出现的情境里，这个功能组最容易成为你默认的应对或行动方式？

prompt.en: For priority 5, “learning, support and absorption comes to the foreground”: When another functional group takes over instead, what changed in the task, relationship, resources or pressure?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 5 条主线「学习、支持与吸收在十神结构中进入前景」：当现实里反而由另一个功能组接管时，任务、关系、资源或压力条件发生了什么变化？

prompt.en: Across your last two or three work settings, which mix of responsibility, output, resources and learning kept repeating?
prompt.zhHans: 回看最近两三个工作环境，责任、输出、资源交换与学习支持中，哪一种组合最常重复？

prompt.en: What kind of role looks suitable on paper but becomes unsustainable once the real carrying cost appears?
prompt.zhHans: 有哪些角色表面上看起来适合，但真正进入持续执行后，会因为承载成本而变得难以长期维持？

prompt.en: When resources accumulate more smoothly, is the key difference production, management, exchange, restraint—or the timing of those actions?
prompt.zhHans: 当资源累积比较顺时，真正的差别更常来自产出、管理、交换、节制，还是行动时机？

prompt.en: Where has the chart-like resource pattern failed to predict reality because market, family obligation or personal choice dominated instead?
prompt.zhHans: 有哪些财富经验并不符合这段结构，因为市场、家庭责任或个人选择反而占了主导？

prompt.en: Which relationship pattern repeats across different people even when the personalities involved are very different?
prompt.zhHans: 即使对象性格完全不同，哪些互动模式仍会在不同关系里重复？

prompt.en: What boundary, expectation or resource condition changes the relationship dynamic most dramatically?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一种边界、期待或资源条件一改变，关系互动就会明显变成另一种样子？

prompt.en: Which family or background pattern is truly persistent across life stages, and which one belonged mainly to a specific period?
prompt.zhHans: 哪些家庭／背景模式跨阶段都持续存在，哪些其实只属于某一个人生时期？

prompt.en: Where does chosen support outside the family reproduce—or correct—the same pattern seen in the original environment?
prompt.zhHans: 家庭以外后来选择的支持系统，在哪些地方重现了原有模式，又在哪些地方修正了它？

prompt.en: Which ability becomes reliable only after repeated practice and support, and which one appears easily but is harder to sustain?
prompt.zhHans: 哪些能力要经过反复练习与支持才会稳定，哪些能力很容易出现，却比较难持续？

prompt.en: What context consistently blocks expression even when the underlying skill is present?
prompt.zhHans: 明明能力已经存在时，哪些情境仍会稳定地阻碍表达或发挥？

prompt.en: What kind of pressure improves focus, and what kind consistently reduces judgment, pacing or recovery?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一种压力会提升专注，哪一种压力反而会持续削弱判断、节奏或恢复？

prompt.en: When the same responsibility becomes easier to carry, what changed first: support, clarity, authority, time or resources?
prompt.zhHans: 同一种责任变得更容易承接时，最先改变的通常是支持、清晰度、权限、时间还是资源？

prompt.en: Over a normal month, where does the cycle of support → output → resource exchange → responsibility flow smoothly, and where does it repeatedly break?
prompt.zhHans: 以一个普通月份来看，支持 → 输出 → 资源交换 → 责任这条循环在哪里最顺，在哪里最容易反复断掉？

prompt.en: What small environmental change produces the largest improvement in your day-to-day operating rhythm?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一个很小的环境调整，最容易带来日常运行节奏上最大的改善？
